$comment: PocketAI hardware profile SELECTION rules (Phase 9). The profiles themselves live in config/profiles/<name>.json (safe / normal / performance). The backend selects ONE profile at startup from detected RAM and re-checks free memory before every inference. The llama.cpp server context is set at launch by the launcher using the selected profile's recommended_server_context; the backend then reads the live server context via GET /props and budgets history/generation within it. All token budgets are conservative because Qwen3.5 is a thinking model: reasoning tokens are generated BEFORE visible content and consume part of max_generation_tokens.
profiles_dir_note: Each *.json file in this folder is one profile; the file stem is the profile id. 'safe' and 'normal' are required; 'performance' is optional.

selection.notes: Total RAM < force_safe_below_total_gb -> always SAFE. Between that and performance_above_total_gb -> NORMAL only if >= normal_requires_free_mb_at_startup is free at startup, else SAFE. Above performance_above_total_gb -> PERFORMANCE if >= performance_requires_free_mb_at_startup is free (and the performance profile exists), else NORMAL. Independent of profile, the backend refuses a new inference (HTTP 503) when free RAM < min_free_ram_mb_for_inference, to keep 8GB machines out of swap. Phase 4 measured peak server RAM: 4.6GB.
